intervention_names: Drug: insulin glargine and insulin aspart
arm_groups.label: Insulin Therapy

brief_summary: To compare efficacy, safety and durability of combination therapy with pioglitazone plus GLP-1 RA versus basal bolus insulin in poorly controlled T2DM patients on metformin plus sulfonylurea
brief_title: Exenatide Plus Pioglitazone Versus Insulin in Poorly Controlled T2DM

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* T2DM poorly controlled (HbA1c \>7.5%) on metformin (\>1700 mg/day) plus sulfonylurea

Exclusion Criteria:

* type 1 diabetes (T1DM) patients receiving therapy with pioglitazone, GLP-1 RA and insulin abnormal kidney, liver or heart function patients with malignancy

official_title: Efficacy and Durability of Glucagon Like Peptide 1 Receptor Agonists (GLP-1 RA)/Thiazolidinedione Versus Basal Bolus Insulin Therapy in Poorly Controlled Type 2 Diabetic Patients (T2DM) Patients on Sulfonylurea Plus Metformin
